title: Best Routine app out there
body: I’ve been wanting to buy premium for a while and was just waiting for the money to come through. I couldn’t say no to the early lifetime offer, I’ve never bought an app before because I don’t think spending real money on virtual things is very smart but this app genuinely helps me. I struggle with some sort of attention deficit disorder but in New Zealand it’s basically impossible to get seen for ADHD right now so I’m just left unseen and undiagnosed for the moment, honestly this is the only thing helping me right now. Mean as app!!
author: Poppi <3
